APPROVED solely for the controlled EP6 C-02 failing-check demonstration at exact `f6330b82a325c119e23d0704565dbdf223377d0e`. **DO NOT MERGE.** This approves the probe's limited scope, not a product change or release.

Independently checked the diff against accepted main `5c04cd4bf7a7a28ff5c429f3770efc42da6bd7e0`: one file, one intentionally wrong expectation (45/60 expects 74 instead of 75). No application, workflow, dependency or deployment file changes; diff whitespace passes. This is a normal non-draft PR targeting main, with no base update required.

Read the actual failure log from [CI 42781653763](https://github.com/auto4496/studytrack/actions/runs/42781653763): database migration/setup succeeds, 116 tests pass and exactly one fails at TEST-F04-03, expected progressPercent74 / received75. The failure is the intended assertion, not a missing dependency or configuration failure. Later browser/build/Docker stages are not claimed to pass.

Live ruleset26925123 is Active and requires one approval plus strict test-and-docker from GitHub Actions app15368; its bypass list is empty and the owner readback says current_user_can_bypass=never. Main still points to the accepted baseline. No rule was changed or bypassed by this review.

This approval intentionally removes the missing-review blocker so the failed required check can be isolated. Retain the post-approval blocked state and a URL-visible merge-box screenshot before B closes the probe unmerged and performs its scoped cleanup. Screenshot evidence and cleanup are separate observations, not established by this review. Do not enable auto-merge, attempt a merge, alter the rule or repair this assertion inside the probe. Keep Issue21 open for the remaining normal protected-path evidence and joint acceptance.
